dogecoin.text: If I, as a teenager who was still in school could recognise that Dogecoin was nothing more than a "mainstream shitcoin", I have a hard time figuring out how the founder of Paypal and SpaceX, CEO of Tesla, Neuralink and the Boring Company doesn't see it as such.

I've been in the crypto space since 2014 and I actually joined through Dogecoin, which was a forked version of Litecoin created both as a joke and as a way to raise awareness of Crypto in general. That's literally it and it took @BillyM2k a couple of hours. He's said so himself
